vi: Dựng Global External HTTP(S) LB từ 5 resource tầng stack: forwarding rule → proxy → URL map → backend service → backend MIG
Hiểu bản chất anycast IP: cùng một IP được quảng bá từ mọi edge POP của Google, mỗi user route tới POP gần nhất
Bật Cloud CDN inline trên backend service qua enable_cdn + cdn_policy, cache hit kiểm qua header Age
Dùng balancing_mode RATE/UTILIZATION/CONNECTION đúng cách theo protocol (HTTP dùng RATE, L4 dùng CONNECTION)
Biết pitfall #1 GCP LB: phải mở firewall cho 2 dải health-check (130.211.0.0/22 + 35.191.0.0/16) kẻo mọi backend báo unhealthy
en: Build Global External HTTP(S) LB from 5-resource stack: forwarding rule → proxy → URL map → backend service → backend MIG
Understand anycast IP essence: one IP advertised from every Google edge POP, each user routed to nearest POP
Enable Cloud CDN inline on backend service via enable_cdn + cdn_policy, verify cache hits with Age header
Use balancing_mode RATE/UTILIZATION/CONNECTION correctly per protocol (HTTP uses RATE, L4 uses CONNECTION)
Know GCP LB pitfall #1: must open firewall for health-check ranges (130.211.0.0/22 + 35.191.0.0/16) or all backends unhealthy
